title: Calling Daddy
can_do: 完成一次短通话：问好、说清事情、问一个问题、礼貌挂断。

conversation_move.label: make a short call to a family member

trigger: Mom and Child are at the market and need Dad's answer about milk, so Child makes the call.
setting: A phone call between the market and home.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Hi Daddy! It's me. We're at the market.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Hello, champ! What are you buying?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mom wants to know: do we need milk?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Yes, please. The big blue bottle.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mom says the big bottle is too heavy.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Then get two small ones instead.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay! Two small bottles. Anything else, Daddy?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Just you, home fast. I miss you!

replay_cards.title: Checking the list
replay_cards.setting: Child and Dad at the market; Mom waits at home.
replay_cards.change: Mom wanted three things but Child remembers only two.
replay_cards.challenge: Child phones Mom to check the list, repeats it back, and adds one question of his own about dinner.

replay_cards.title: The goodnight call
replay_cards.challenge: Child calls Dad, says goodnight, tells one thing about his day, and closes the call politely.

parent_support: 让孩子真的打一两个短电话（问爸爸要不要买东西）。
通话前和孩子排一遍骨架：问好、说事、问一句、说再见。
挂电话后复述要点：“爸爸要两小瓶奶，还要什么来着？”练习听记。
